features.name: Co-pilot for Business Central
features.description: AI-powered assistant across ERP and CRM that was introduced in March 2023 with initial marketing text suggestions capability, now expanded with a toolkit for developers to add new generative AI skills and capabilities.
caveats: Designed for Business Central online (SaaS) only
Uses Azure OpenAI Service
Intended for non-conversational experiences with human review
Not for building chatbots

features.name: Generative AI Developer Toolkit
features.description: New toolkit enabling partners to build generative AI features and skills into Business Central extensions, including signature co-pilot user experience, AI module for Azure OpenAI interaction, guides, samples, and administration/telemetry functions.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can get Hands-On right now if you're an Insider using Insider builds you already have access to the toolkit today
caveats: Currently available to Insider builds
Will be included in Wave 2 minor update for online deployment

features.name: Prompt Dialogue Page Type
features.description: New page type added to AL development that provides a consistent co-pilot user experience for non-conversational generative AI features. Includes prompt area for user input and system action for generation orchestration.
caveats: Page type is not extensible to maintain trust and consistency
Preview badge recommended for initial feature releases

features.name: Sparkle Image Property for Co-pilot Actions
features.description: New image property option for actions in the command bar that signals to users this will be an intelligent co-pilot-powered experience, providing consistency across different co-pilot implementations.

features.name: System Actions for Generate
features.description: New AL construct that allows developers to provide specific actions controlled by the platform, enabling orchestration between UI parts and behaviors while giving developers control over generation logic.

features.name: Progress Dialogue for Generation
features.description: Built-in progress bar that appears during AI generation across all prompt dialogues with automatic start/stop and optional cancellation support, requiring no additional AL developer work by default.
caveats: Text can be overridden using existing progress dialogue APIs

features.name: Draft Project Plan Feature
features.description: Example generative AI feature that allows users to generate a project plan with tasks and job details for the Jobs module by providing keywords and a natural language prompt, with ability to regenerate based on parameter adjustments.
caveats: Example only for demonstration purposes
Actual implementation requires further configuration

features.name: Data Caption Expression for Prompt Display
features.description: Feature that uses data caption expression in the page header to show the user's natural language prompt input instead of the static page caption, creating a visual connection between the user's request and the output.
caveats: Recommended technique, not mandatory

features.name: OnQueryClosedPage Trigger for Keep/Discard
features.description: Developers use the OnQueryClosedPage trigger from task dialogues to handle user actions when they click keep it, discard it, or cancel buttons to communicate the result back to the developer.
caveats: Can also use value returned from page.Run model

features.name: Override Keep/Discard Captions with System Actions
features.description: System actions in the system action area allow developers to override the default okay cancel captions without requiring triggers, providing caption and tooltip only.
caveats: Purely provides caption and tooltip
Uses OnQueryClosedPage trigger as the way to choose keep or discard

features.name: Edit Prompt Before Keep/Discard
features.description: Users can edit the prompt they provided before keeping or discarding the output by clicking in the corner of the page to edit it. The platform handles the transition and regeneration automatically.
caveats: No developer work needed for orchestration and transitions

features.name: Regenerate System Action
features.description: New system action called regenerate that appears as a button in the command bar, allowing users to get multiple versions or iterations of the generated output.
caveats: Requires adding to system action area to be available

features.name: Prompt Options Area
features.description: New area added to the prompt dialogue page for option fields that appear as drop-downs in the footer. These allow users to tweak the generation process by controlling tone, format, or other parameters that don't influence the facts.
caveats: Should use option fields as drop-downs
Only affects tone or format, not core facts

features.name: Source Table for Generation History
features.description: Using a source table on the prompt dialogue page to show different versions of generated output, allowing users to traverse through multiple iterations. Source tables should be temporary to require user confirmation before accepting output.
caveats: Tables should be temporary
Prevents accidental commits

features.name: Attach System Action for File Upload
features.description: System action called attach that creates a paperclip icon in the footer, allowing developers to use file upload APIs to prompt users to upload files for use in copilot generation.
caveats: Uses existing file upload APIs

features.name: Direct Generation with Prompt Mode
features.description: Developers can control how the prompt dialogue page opens by setting the prompt mode to generate in the OnOpen page trigger, causing the page to immediately call the generate action and go directly to the loading state.
caveats: Used when developer already has needed information

features.name: AI Module for Copilot Generation
features.description: Module in the system application that supports Azure OpenAI service including LLMs like text chat and embeddings. Provides control and viewing of copilot capabilities within the environment and telemetry for tracking usage, registration, and errors.
caveats: Does not support image generation using DALL-E
Does not support transcribing text with Whisper
Does not support Speech to Text with Whisper

features.name: Copilot Capability Registration
features.description: System that requires each extension to register its copilot capability using the copilot capability code unit and by extending the copilot capability enum. Failure to register results in an error that the capability enum is not used or not registered.
caveats: Each extension must register separately
Enum must be extended
Error thrown if capability not registered

features.name: Azure OpenAI Text Completion
features.description: Object and methods for text completions using Azure OpenAI service. Includes optional text completion parameters for customization and returns the exact text output from generation.
caveats: Returns text value directly
Optional parameters can be modified

features.name: Azure OpenAI Chat Completions
features.description: Support for chat completions using Azure OpenAI with chat messages and chat completion parameters. Similar to text completions but with different parameters and support for chat roles.
caveats: Different parameters than text completion

features.name: Embeddings with Azure OpenAI
features.description: Support for embeddings using Azure OpenAI service. No specific optional parameters object for embeddings, as embeddings do not have any optional parameters.
caveats: No optional parameters available
Get result returns a JSON list

features.name: Azure OpenAI Operation Response
features.description: Object that allows developers to get the result of Azure OpenAI operations as a JsonToken of what was returned, providing alternative access to generation results compared to direct return values.
caveats: Result is JsonToken format
Minor difference from direct return values

features.name: Azure OpenAI Authorization
features.description: Setup of authorization credentials including resource URL, deployment name, and API key for Azure OpenAI service integration.
caveats: Should not hardcode keys in extensions
Use isolated storage or AppSource key vault
Each deployment is a specific model type

features.name: Meta Prompts for AI Generation
features.description: Custom system prompts that define the model's profile, expected output format, examples, and behavioral guardrails for AI generation.
caveats: Example provided does not encompass all limitations and safeguards
Developers should define behavioral safeguards and examples

features.name: Optional Parameters for AI Generation
features.description: Parameters like temperature, max tokens, and presence penalty that control model behavior; only supported for chat and text completions, not embeddings.
caveats: Not all Azure OpenAI parameters are supported
Parameter 'n' for multiple generations is not supported
Embeddings have no optional parameters

features.name: Copilot and AI Capabilities Administration Page
features.description: Admin page for managing AI capabilities registered in Business Central, showing transparency of all features from Microsoft, partners, and customizations, with ability to deactivate capabilities.
caveats: Displays both preview and generally available capabilities
Administrators can deactivate features
Deactivation reasons are captured and shared with developers

features.name: Azure OpenAI Regional Deployment with Automatic Detection
features.description: Customers in regions with Azure OpenAI service deployed require no additional setup. Admins in regions without local Azure OpenAI service must opt-in to allow Business Central to contact out-of-region services. Some customers are automatically opted in but can opt out.
caveats: Admins must review privacy and compliance before opting in to out-of-region services
Assumes models deployed to same regions as Azure OpenAI endpoints

features.name: Copilot On by Default with No Master Kill Switch
features.description: Copilot is now enabled by default and available as part of Business Central. There is no master kill switch for Copilot.
caveats: Individual features can still be deactivated by admins

features.name: Responsible AI Principles and Guidelines
features.description: Microsoft has established ethical AI principles including fairness, reliability, safety, privacy and security, inclusiveness, transparency, and accountability. Guidelines and materials are provided to help extensions assess features against these principles.

features.name: AI-generated Content Disclaimer on Output Screens
features.description: Every output screen and prompt dialogue automatically displays a disclaimer stating 'AI generated content may be incorrect' to help customers understand the limitations of AI-generated content.
caveats: Developers do not need to add this disclaimer themselves

features.name: Sparkle Action Image for Copilot Prompts
features.description: A new Sparkle action image indicator that developers can use on actions to signal that Copilot is at work when opening the dialogue. Recommended alongside terminology like 'draft', 'generate', 'suggest', or 'copilot'.

features.name: User Feedback Through Prompt Dialogue
features.description: Users can like or dislike outputs from Copilot and provide reasons for their feedback. This feedback is monitored through Application Insights and Power BI to track quality and adoption of AI features.

features.name: Telemetry Signals for Usage and Adoption Tracking
features.description: Developers can access telemetry signals to understand how their AI features are being used and adopted across different regions, enabling data-driven improvements.

features.name: Prompt Engineering with Safety Mechanisms
features.description: Developers are advised to engineer prompts with additional safety mechanisms including meta prompts and content filtering, particularly for creative use cases like job project breakdown generation.
caveats: Developers need to proactively add safety mechanisms beyond toolkit defaults
Team is working on providing more safety assistance through the toolkit

features.name: Marketing Text Suggestions Built-in Capability
features.description: One of two built-in Copilot capabilities that come with Business Central. Generates marketing text suggestions using generative AI.

features.name: Bank Account Reconciliation Assistance Built-in Capability
features.description: One of two built-in Copilot capabilities that come with Business Central. Provides AI assistance for bank account reconciliation tasks.
